audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 phase is boilerplate claiming your Q-poke wins the stage while the side is Gnar.
audit.why: Boomerang Throw is an 1100-range projectile against your 625-range Seismic Shard; you cannot contest the poke, you can only soak it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 why rewritten around the range gap and the hop.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 phase gives no trigger for when to step up.
audit.why: Hop is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s — it is his only escape, so the window after he spends it is the whole stage.
audit.corrected: Phase rewritten around Hop's cooldown and Ground Slam cutting Hyper's attack speed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers say 'boomerang', 'hop', 'mega-Gnar's W stun' instead of Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Hop / Crunch and Wallop, and GNAR! is tracked as if it were always available.
audit.why: Riot gives Gnar paired names per form and GNAR! only exists in Mega, so the ability to track is the Rage bar plus Hop, not a permanent ultimate.
audit.corrected: Real names written into the spikes and foe wants; Key Ability Interactions re-pointed at Hop and the Mega-only ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing lines and the cooldown block has no numbers.
audit.why: GNAR! 90/60/30, Hop 22s to 12s, Boomerang Throw 16s to 10s and reduced when he catches it, Hyper 7s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown, the first Do and the Levels 4-5 phase.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Gnar contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw out-ranges you 1100 to 625 and chips Granite Shield before it refreshes. Last-hit at Q range, never chase the hop.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around GNAR!'s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Hop is 22s at rank 1 — once he spends it he has no exit, so walk up then and let Ground Slam cut Hyper's attack speed.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR!: matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Dodge/R-peel it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - GNAR! (R): 90s at rank 1 and Mega-only — no Rage, no answer to your engage. - Hop (E): 22s at rank 1, his one escape, so commit after it. - Boomerang Throw (Q): 16s, shorter if he catches it.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Dodge/R-peel it. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Hop (E) is 22s at rank 1 — engage after he spends it. GNAR! only exists while he is in Mega.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Dodge/R-peel it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His Mega all-in, 90s at rank 1. Fight while the Rage bar is empty.

edits.before: Mini-Gnar boomerang and hop-poke chips your Granite Shield before it can refresh — eat it, last-hit with Q range, don't chase the hops.
edits.after: Mini-Gnar's Boomerang Throw and Hop poke chip Granite Shield before it refreshes — eat it, last-hit at Q range, do not chase the hops.

edits.before: Stay in mini form and kite with boomerang (Q) + hop (E) so your short-range kit never connects
edits.after: Stay in mini and kite with Boomerang Throw (Q) and Hop (E) so your short-range kit never connects

edits.before: Build his Rage bar so mega-Gnar's W stun and R wall are up to answer your Unstoppable Force
edits.after: Build Rage so Wallop (W) and GNAR! (R) are banked to answer your Unstoppable Force

edits.before: Ground Slam (E) and W sustain mean you out-trade a kiting mini-Gnar; punish any window where his Rage bar is low and there's no mega stun banked.
edits.after: Ground Slam (E) and W sustain out-trade a kiting mini-Gnar; step up the moment his Hop (22s at rank 1) is spent and the Rage bar is low.

notes: The full-layer TL;DR claims 'His %HP hurts', but nothing in Gnar's Riot descriptions or derived flags is percent-max-health — left untouched and logged as unverified rather than rewritten. Malphite's kit derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support; no grounding claim written.
